notes: Mapped XMC1302 SRAM 0x20000000-0x20003FFF (initialized) so Ghidra can hold types. Stack init is 0x20003210.

Ride state is two adjacent objects, not one: RideControlState at 0x2000251C (RunRideControlLoop / DispatchMotorControlTimeslice) and RideSensorState at 0x20002558 (CompareWheelSpeedCeiling / UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod / UpdateTorqueSensorState). 0x20002558 == 0x2000251C+0x3C.

Walk/assist current target is RideControlState+0x12 (0x2000252E). Wheel speed km/h<<5 is RideSensorState+0x38 (0x20002590). CompareWheelSpeedCeiling now decompiles as ride_state->wWheelSpeedKmhX32 versus 25<<5.
Init 1000 at 0x200025AC is RideSensorState+0x54 (wLiveWheelForFade). Init 728 at 0x2000258A is +0x32 (wSpeedFadeLow). They are used via the object pointer, so they are not write-only.
Scatter-load table ScatterLoadEntry[3] at 0x100073a0: RAM code 0x20000000 size 0x243C, init data 0x2000243C size 0x404, BSS 0x20002840 size 0x9D0 up to the stack.
Did not rename functions. Flash pointer literals were typed (RideControlState*, RideSensorState*, RideStatusFlags*, byte*) so decompiler field coverage rises.

globals.purpose: Inner-loop ride object: timeslice ready +0x01, hall +0x03, current target +0x12, battery current +0x16, ADC accums +0x24..+0x30.
Sensor/speed view of ride state. Wheel speed km/h<<5 at +0x38, fade table +0x30/+0x32, live fade wheel +0x54, torque capture +0x2A.
Protect dword + assist dword. Bit 0x40000 is assist-allow; CompareWheelSpeedCeiling clears it at >=25 km/h. Second dword holds debounce/torque/hall bits.
Display PAS 0-6. UART 0x59 flag bits write here; 6 is walk. Init default 5.
Live display max-speed km/h. UART stores only when the speed byte is > 10. Feeds wheel fade rebuild.
Live Tongsheng wheel-size code (valid 6-34). Display overwrites the 0x1C init default.
Last-applied speed used with last wheel code to rebuild +0x30/+0x32 fade table.
Last-applied wheel-size code paired with last speed for fade rebuild. Init writes 0x1C.
Copy of g_wFullCurrentLimit taken at init; fade path also writes this snapshot.
PAS percent cell: 0/30/50/70/85/100 for PAS 0-5. Walk stores 0.
Assist current-target word from ApplyAssistLevelTargets. Clamps RideControlState.wCurrentTarget.
Scaled assist from PAS math. PAS 5 copies g_wMaxCurrentSetpoint here.
Held assist word; torque-override path copies g_wPriorAssistWord here.
Full current-limit setpoint. PAS 1-5 target and upper clamp on ride-state +0x12.
Max current setpoint for PAS 5 and walk-scale source. Init seed 0x1194 is written to sensor +0x38, not here.
Prior assist snapshot used when pedal-torque override holds assist.
Bit0 of UART 0x59 flags byte 1. Zero selects the off-road GPIO path in UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod.
Ride-loop gate byte. Init 0; bit 5 set when a related cell reads 0xA9.
Aux display byte cleared at init, adjacent to assist percent.
Slewed torque ADC average used when g_wAdcFilterControl bit0 is 0.
Unfiltered four-sample torque average when filter bit0 is set.
Word zeroed in InitializeRideDefaults.
Overcurrent event/hold timer in UpdateBatteryCurrentLimit.
Battery current limit reference; init copies the seed halfword here.
32-bit copy of the ride-init seed (ADC-related).
Second 32-bit seed copy.
Overcurrent debounce; four counts raise protect bits.
ApplyWheelSpeedFade current output from sensor fade table vs live wheel.
ApplyWheelSpeedFade assist output; zeroed below the high fade limit.
Bit0 selects raw vs slewed torque average in the ride loop.
Reload used when programming the ride SysTick divider.
Latest ReadAdcChannelLow sample stored each ride-loop iteration.
Display UART protocol block. Init 0x43 at [0], 0x46 at [9]. ParseDisplayUartFrame fills +0x0A..+0x14.
Second UART header. Init 0x46, 0x16, 1, plus two flash-copied bytes.
Start of copied RAM code (scatter-load size 0x243C). Contains all 15 EXT_FUN veneers.
Start of initialized SRAM data (scatter-load size 0x404). Includes ride-state and display settings.
Start of SRAM BSS (scatter-load zeros 0x9D0 bytes up to stack).
Initial SP from the vector table at 0x10001000. Stack grows down.

ride_state_fields.name: bTimesliceCounter
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: DispatchMotorControlTimeslice increments *rideState; wraps at 100 and calls FUN_10002330.

ride_state_fields.name: bTimesliceReady
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: inner slot 5 writes 1; RunRideControlLoop waits until this is 1.

ride_state_fields.name: bHallCommutation
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: low 3 bits of a CCU/status word. 0 or 7 increments a fault timer then sets assist-flags bit 0x800000.

ride_state_fields.name: bInnerSubslot
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: nested 1-10 dispatcher for UART/current/fault/RAM-slot work.

ride_state_fields.name: wBattCurrentSampleCount
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: UpdateBatteryCurrentLimit sample counter; every 16 samples publishes an average.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueAvgCount
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: counts ADC samples; every 4 samples the torque/current averages are published.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueAdcAvg
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: four-sample averaged torque/ADC used as cadence/current staging input.

ride_state_fields.name: wStagedCurrent
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: cadence-derived current staging before slewing +0x12.

ride_state_fields.name: wStallTimer
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: stall timer; 1000 ticks with stall-enable set clears the enable flag.

ride_state_fields.name: wCurrentTarget
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: live assist/walk current target. PAS==6 stores 450 (0x1C2). Copied out to sensor+0x16.

ride_state_fields.name: wAltCurrentTarget
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: alternate current target (throttle/limit path) slewed into +0x12.

ride_state_fields.name: wBatteryCurrent
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: latest battery-current sample from FUN_100023f8.

ride_state_fields.name: wShuntAvg
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: averaged shunt/phase value; <0x4B / <0x5C gates a brake-like protect bit 0x2000000.

ride_state_fields.name: wPhaseAdc
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: second ADC (FUN_10002420) sampled into +0x2C accum.

ride_state_fields.name: wProtectCompare
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: compared to 0x2D1 in the nested timeslice current-headroom path.

ride_state_fields.name: dwBattCurrentAccum
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: 16-sample battery current accumulator.

ride_state_fields.name: dwTorqueAccum
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: four-sample torque ADC accumulator.

ride_state_fields.name: dwPhaseAccum
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: four-sample phase/shunt accumulator.

ride_state_fields.name: dwHighAdcAccum
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideControlState@0x2000251C: four-sample ReadAdcChannelHigh accumulator.

ride_state_fields.name: wPublishedCurrentTarget
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: published copy of control +0x12 (absolute 0x2000256E). Torque path compares related speed/current fields to 900.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueSpeedCmp
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: compared to 0x321 (801) with capture in UpdateTorqueSensorState.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueEventCount
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: torque event counter; capped at 10 before delta-check.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueHoldCount
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: torque hold/timeout; 400 and 600 thresholds in UpdateTorqueSensorState.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueConfirmCount
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: confirmation counter; >2 sets assist-flags bit 0x10.

ride_state_fields.name: wTorqueCapture
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: CCU/timer capture stored from peripheral-0xC when an IRQ flag is set.

ride_state_fields.name: wWheelPeriodRaw
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: raw wheel period; CompareWheelSpeedCeiling stores (value>>6) as a status byte.

ride_state_fields.name: wSpeedFadeHigh
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: high fade limit (absolute 0x20002588). Init 641; UpdateWheelSpeedPeriod rebuilds from wheel code and display speed.

ride_state_fields.name: wSpeedFadeLow
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: low fade limit (absolute 0x2000258A). Init 728 (0x2D8).

ride_state_fields.name: wWheelSpeedKmhX32
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: wheel speed in km/h<<5 (absolute 0x20002590). Init 0x1194. Ceiling: if >= 25<<5 (800) and protect bit2 clear, assist-allow 0x40000 is cleared.

ride_state_fields.name: bUartClearLo
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: ParseDisplayUartFrame zeros +0x4C/+0x4D after a good 0x59 checksum.

ride_state_fields.name: wLiveWheelForFade
ride_state_fields.meaning: RideSensorState@0x20002558: live wheel value compared to fade table (absolute 0x200025AC). Init 1000.

ram_veneers.name: EXT_FUN_20000544
ram_veneers.purpose: Copied-to-RAM code. Flash veneer pushes the RAM address and pops it into PC. Do not treat as an exploit gadget.

ram_veneers.name: EXT_FUN_2000017c
ram_veneers.purpose: Copied-to-RAM motor enable/disable helper used on PWM on/off and idle-trip.

ram_veneers.name: EXT_FUN_20002422
ram_veneers.purpose: Copied-to-RAM hall-sector PWM helper. Highest veneer; still inside the 0x243C RAM-code image.
